budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Plan where your money goes before it goes anywhere.
budget.loadError: Your budgets could not be loaded.
budget.detailLoadError: This budget could not be loaded.

empty.title: Start a new budget
empty.description: Start with a draft: pick your currency, add your envelopes, then publish when it feels right.
empty.onlyOwner: The profile owner creates budgets for this profile.
empty.lockedTitle: Your first budget is on its way
empty.lockedDescription: It unlocks after 30 days of records and a transaction in every envelope.
empty.readyTitle: Your first budget is ready to draft
empty.readyDescription: We'll pre-fill it from your last 30 days. You decide the rest.

table.variableNote: Variable amounts are expected values — re-adjust them any time with a budget revision.
table.notSaved: A change could not be saved.
table.invalidAmount: Not saved: enter a whole amount of 1 or more.
table.label: Budget envelopes

addEnvelope.title: Add an envelope
addEnvelope.description: Assign one of your envelopes to this budget with its planned amount.
addEnvelope.allAssigned: All your envelopes are already in this budget.

create.title: Create a new budget
create.description: Start with a draft — pick the currency you will budget in.

clone.title: Create a new budget?
clone.description: A draft copy of this budget will be created — same envelopes, ready for your adjustments. The currency is pre-filled from the current budget.

share.title: Share budget
share.draftTransferNote: A draft budget can only be handed to the profile owner. Publish it first to transfer it to someone else.

confirm.publishDescription: Publishing stamps this budget for {month} and puts it in read-only mode. This cannot be undone.
confirm.replaceWarning: The budget already published for {month} will be replaced: it is deleted with its envelope assignments and shares.
confirm.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the budget with all of its envelope assignments and shares.
